reviews.text: Venture Pools just finished transforming my backyard from nothing to something amazing!! From the start Brad made sure to listen to what we wanted and designed our back porch and pool perfectly! We live right next to a creek so it was super important to make the design work with the way water flows into our backyard when it rains. Mark and Carlos had great communication about what was happening during the construction phase and answered all my questions when I had some. The ladies in the back we

This was our second build with Venture, and the experience was just as solid as the first. Mark understood my wife’s vision from the start and turned it into a design that needed no change orders. He added thoughtful details we wouldn’t have considered, all while keeping the look and feel she wanted.

John managed the project with real ownership—communicating early, addressing issues before they became problems, and keeping everything on track.

The finished backyard is exactly what we hoped for

We highly recommend Venture Custom Pools. They were able to transform my backyard from an empty space with grass to an oasis. Our great experience started in the design phase. Mark from design, listened to our ideas. He was able to show us what our back would look like when completed. We were impressed and excited.
As with any construction, delays and issues can happen. Sometimes we cannot control it. However, Brett (construction manager), Amanda (office) and Angelica (office) kept us on track t

We were referred to Venture from friends after having reached out to several other companies. From the beginning with Ken in the design process to help us design our pool was amazing. He listened to what we wanted and came up with an amazing design. Brett was our project manager and he did an outstanding job! He was easy to talk to and responded to any questions or concerns we had. We were nervous about starting such a major project since you mostly hear negative experiences with pool building a

Geoff Waco led the team and did a terrific job with our pool. They came all the way out to our new home in Lake Kiowa and we just love our pool! This is our second Venture pool!  Thanks Venture - Gregg and Geoff for giving us our happily ever after 😇👍😀

The pool that Venture custom built for us was splendid. Make sure you do your own research when building a pool! Know what components and features you want in a pool or you may get pool builders upselling you on it (this is for inground). We went with Venture Custom Pools after interviewing about 5 different builders.

Below is a breakdown of how we selected our pool builder.

In order:

1. Picked a pool company that was willing to work with our budget, had a good track record of building pools

Geoff and his staff did an amazing job building our backyard oasis.  I love that the Venture Pool designer offered an entire design package including the landscape.  The entire staff made our experience one we will always remember and recommend to all our friends.

I highly recommend considering Venture Custom Pool for your pool construction needs. I recently had my pool built by them, and the construction took place from October 2023 to February 2024. Mark Leuthold, the Senior Construction Consultant, did an exceptional job in meeting our requirements while staying within a reasonable budget. He presented an excellent initial design proposal based on our initial discussions and was very accommodating in making modifications to suit our preferences. The ab

Venture Custom Pools built our pool in 4 weeks and it looks AMAZING. We’re absolutely satisfied with everything they’ve done for us, and especially with the communication with Buddy, our project manager. They handled everything perfectly and it all went faster than the timeline we originally got. I would 100% recommend these guys. Thanks for your professionalism and quality of work!

I’m a general contractor myself,  and really wanted to build the pool myself, but I wanted to be 100% sure that it was going to be supervised from someone with years of dedication and experience specially with in-ground pools. I shopped around and meet several sales people. I wanted a quality built pool for a fair price but also and more importantly backed by a company with a strong backbone.

I have heard several pool companies starting jobs and then shut down their doors. This is why I went wi

John Williams  Venture Custom Pools just a Special Thank you for the expert support you provided throughout removal & enstallation of the new pool equipment. Your frequent communications were outstanding. Thanks again for the exceptional service!

I would highly recommend Venture Pools for your consideration.  The overall experience was marked by professionalism. Bret the project manager was responsive and accommodating and Angelica was on point with scheduling.  The finished product excelled my expectations.

Venture did an awesome job from design to finish on our pool.  Mark Leuthold’s design was perfect and he helped guide us through material and color selection.  Bret was their hands on supervisor, overseeing every aspect of the job from start to finish.  We are thrilled at the entire process and would highly recommend Venture Pools to build your pool.

The whole experience of building a new pool was way easier than I expected. The crew showed up on time and actually cared about the little details. You can tell they used quality materials because everything feels solid and well made.

They helped us reimagine our older home with a complete remodel. The design was creative, and the builders were clearly skilled at what they do. The results look modern but still kept the character we loved.

Had a great experience working with Mark and Bret. Marks design for our unique space was far and away better than any of the other designs from other companies. Very impressed. Execution has been great and they’ve been attentive to addressing any concerns or changes we have had or made along with way. It’s been an amazing to see it come together so quickly.

Working with Venture pools was one of the best decisions we have made for our home ! It’s always hard to figure out who can you put your trust in on such a big investment . Venture pools brought our vision to life and everyone involved especially our project manager Geoff Waco and our project designer Ken Green were on top of it and delivered! They made us feel very comfortable with the process and gave us a realistic time frame of completion. Not to mention I think our pool may have been done i

I had a great experience with Venture pools. As with any build, it is inevitable to run into issues, and Amanda from their office was great at following up with resolutions and keeping on top of the contractors. She continued to follow up on unresolved issues after construction was complete, until everything was pretty much perfect. Josh, my construction manager was great and always willing to answer questions.
The Venture contractors are polite, does quality work, and leaves a clean work site.

I couldn't be happier with the professionalism & service I received from Venture pools! I not only got an awesome fully custom shaped salt water pool but also got to pick out every detail from the stone, to the color of the plaster etc. Everyone I worked with during the process was very responsive, exceptional and friendly including the different construction crews in all the phases of the process. Tim Cassel was our initial first contact & sales person who came out to measure the yard and provi
Our yard has a great view, but we never used it. They positioned the pool and deck to perfectly frame the sunset. Now we have front row seats every single night. Thanks Venture

reviews.author: Shawnya Dickson

reviews.text:
The pool that Venture custom built for us was splendid. Make sure you do your own research when building a pool! Know what components and features you want in a pool or you may get pool builders upselling you on it (this is for inground). We went with Venture Custom Pools after interviewing about 5 different builders.

Below is a breakdown of how we selected our pool builder.

In order:

1. Picked a pool company that was willing to work with our budget, had a good track record of building pools (# of pools built the past 2-3 years. Had good sales/revenue records to prove that they build pools -- had reliable/stable trade-crews w/ good reputation).

- Venture checked that box.

2. Picked a pool company that had good warranties (not just the pool equipment but craftsmanship warranties as well so they follow-up and fix/address problematic tiles, coping, defects, etc.)

- Venture checked that box and has addressed issues (nothing ever goes to plan or is perfect..)

3. We cared a lot about customer service (once the contract was signed) so we wanted to make sure we picked a pool company with good communication skills (I asked to make sure our project manager (Thanks Bret!) would update us frequently, be available to answer questions, etc.. throughout the whole process. If I didn't sense the pool company would be transparent and communicative, I moved on to the next pool company (some companies will seem to be responsive until you sign with them).

-Venture assigned Bret who made himself available to us throughout the entire process

4. Know what components and features you want or don't want in a pool or you may get pool builders upselling you on it (this is for inground). Also, stick to your budget and ask what options you have!

-Venture understood what I wanted and what we were looking for (didn't try to upsell us). They made suggestions but my family and I knew where we were going to spend and where we were going to go lower cost on.

Ultimately, what was most important to us was a company that would stand behind their work, team and deliver (not necessarily on-time but close to it). Venture Custom Pools did that.

With any project, there were delays due to weather (rain/hail) and scheduling issues due to backed up clients. My family didn't expect the schedule to go to plan even though Venture said it could be done on a given timeline. While it could've obviously gone better, faster, and efficient, we felt Venture Custom was better than the other builders we interviewed because they were willing to fix issues post-build.

Would we build a pool with them again? The answer is Yes.

If Venture Custom Pools could improve here is what I would suggest employees at Venture Custom Pools focus on.

- Explain all the options of what is possible given the budget
- Explain the soil injections (pool shell/decking)
- Ask how we want our pool to be cleaned (robot, suction-wall, auto cleaning features)
- Explain why sand or cartridge is better
- Explain salt vs. chlorine
- Explain auto-fill water vs. manual fill
- Explain how important positioning/placement of pool lights are, not just about led strength
- Explain drain holes and its locations and why
- Explain why one would need 1 or 2 skimmers
- Be proactive in scheduling and informing clients of when trades are scheduled and when it has been re-scheduled for a later date.

In general, I enjoyed my pool building experience. If you're looking for a company that will work with you to get what you want done pick Venture Custom Pools over the many out here in the DFW area.

Remember, the cost of building a pool is typically more than an expensive luxury vehicle (the one we built was our second largest purchase -- second to our home).

Pick a high-quality pool builder like Venture Custom Pools that have good crews (trades) and will support and fix issues that arise...(because there will be!).
reviews.author: Jeffrey Ee

reviews.text: Geoff and his staff did an amazing job building our backyard oasis.  I love that the Venture Pool designer offered an entire design package including the landscape.  The entire staff made our experience one we will always remember and recommend to all our friends.
reviews.author: Bridgett Green

reviews.text:
I highly recommend considering Venture Custom Pool for your pool construction needs. I recently had my pool built by them, and the construction took place from October 2023 to February 2024. Mark Leuthold, the Senior Construction Consultant, did an exceptional job in meeting our requirements while staying within a reasonable budget. He presented an excellent initial design proposal based on our initial discussions and was very accommodating in making modifications to suit our preferences. The ability to view a virtual image of the proposed pool was incredibly convenient and allowed us to visualize the final outcome before any work began. Mark provided valuable suggestions and guidance based on his extensive knowledge and experience, which was immensely helpful throughout the process.
Following the finalization of the design, we were introduced to Buddy Phillips, the Construction Manager, who efficiently organized the construction timeline. Buddy was proactive in keeping us informed of any delays or issues that arose during the construction phase. Whenever we had questions, Buddy promptly provided comprehensive answers, ensuring we remained fully informed throughout the project. Additionally, as we had to travel internationally during the construction period, Buddy was accommodating in rescheduling the construction activities to ensure we could observe crucial stages of the process. Even after the construction was finished, Buddy continued to offer strong support by addressing our inquiries and attending to post-construction requirements. He dedicated considerable time to thoroughly explain the operation instructions for the pool and promptly responded to any questions we had, spending hours ensuring we were fully informed.
Overall, our experience with Venture Custom Pool, Mark, and Buddy exceeded our expectations, and we are thrilled with the final result of our pool.
reviews.author: Jeung Ki Yoo
